answer: Verifiable Delay Draw. Each round, a public delay function output seeds selection of a small committee from all registered agents; selection probability rises with distinct device attestations. An attacker cannot precompute winners because the seed emerges only after sequential hashing completes. Duplicates must each hold separate hardware roots, costing a full attestation per identity, while a lone pearl of real usage rarely wins yet gains from honest depth. Selected agents report on a jetty of shared logs; unchosen copies on the same island cannot inherit rewards.
